recognize_zh: 皮膚切片真皮層被密集的非典型細胞瀰漫浸潤，表皮正常且與浸潤之間有一條未受侵犯的 Grenz zone，高倍下細胞穿插於膠原纖維之間、核細緻摺疊、染色質細、核仁明顯，形態為骨髓性肉瘤（myeloid sarcoma）的皮膚浸潤。
features: Dense, diffuse dermal infiltrate occupying the full thickness of the punch biopsy (low power)
Unremarkable epidermis separated from the infiltrate by an uninvolved Grenz zone
Atypical medium to large cells dissecting between and splaying dermal collagen bundles
Delicately folded or irregular nuclei with fine chromatin and frequently prominent nucleoli
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; scattered mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies
describe_en: Skin punch biopsy shows an extensive, diffuse dermal infiltrate involving the full thickness of the specimen, with an intact overlying epidermis and a preserved Grenz zone. At higher power, atypical medium to large mononuclear cells infiltrate between collagen bundles in a single-file and sheet-like pattern. The cells have delicately folded nuclei, fine chromatin, frequently prominent nucleoli, and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, with scattered mitoses. There is no epidermotropism or nesting. The morphology is that of a hematolymphoid neoplasm with blastic/monocytoid features; with supportive immunohistochemistry (CD33, lysozyme, CD68), findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma (leukemia cutis).

ddx.vs: BPDCN also spares the epidermis with a Grenz zone, but it is CD123, TCL1 and CD4/CD56 positive and lacks myelomonocytic markers such as lysozyme, CD33 and MPO.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type / cutaneous lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphomas express B- or T-cell markers (CD20, PAX5, CD3) and are negative for lysozyme and CD33, which requires immunohistochemistry to separate.

ddx.dx: Merkel cell carcinoma / metastatic small cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Merkel cell carcinoma has salt-and-pepper chromatin, nuclear molding and CK20 dot-like and neuroendocrine marker positivity, and is CD45-negative.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous histiocytic infiltrate / Langerhans cell histiocytosis
ddx.vs: LCH cells have grooved kidney-shaped nuclei with eosinophils and express CD1a and langerin, often with epidermotropism.
